resources.string: Blocks YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels to protect your focus

FocusLite monitors YouTube and Instagram to detect when addictive short-form video reels or shorts are opened. It triggers a back navigation action to return you to your previous screen without closing the app. FocusLite processes all events locally on your device and does not read or store private personal data.
FocusLite is actively monitoring and protecting your attention.
To detect and exit short-form feeds, FocusLite requires Android Accessibility permission.
Instantly exits the Shorts player while keeping standard videos, search, and subscriptions active.
Instantly exits the Reels viewer while allowing normal feed posts, stories, and direct messages (DMs).
FocusLite operates 100% on your device with zero network access. Your messages, searches, and browsing history are never tracked, recorded, or sent anywhere.
